text: The stream can show which raw rows are pending, but nothing processes them yet. This video builds the Snowflake Task that does: a scheduled MERGE into a clean, curated table.

Two things have to be right: the MERGE itself, keyed on transaction_id so a retry can never double-count, and the schedule, gated on SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA so the warehouse doesn't even wake up when there's nothing new.
MERGE_POS_TRANSACTIONS_TASK runs every five minutes against LOAD_WH, merging the stream straight into CURATED.POS_TRANSACTIONS_CLEAN.
Here's the part that's easy to miss: every Snowflake task is created suspended. The SQL can be flawless and it still won't run until you explicitly resume it -- and confirm STARTED, not just created.
With the task verified running against TASK_HISTORY, curated data is now current within minutes. Next: the gold models built on top of it.
